title: Grateful Dead Live at The Spectrum on 1986-03-24
lineage: MAC >> Nakamichi DR-1 => Grace Design Lunatec v3 => Korg MR-1000 >> DSF [1-bit 5.6448 MHz Stereo] >> Korg MR-1000 => Korg AudioGate >> WAV [24/96]
source: 2 x AKG C460 CK61uls > Uher CR240 > Master Audience Cassette (FOB)

ai_review.summary: High‑quality soundboard mix of a solid performance makes this the go‑to version of the show.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers praise the balance and clarity of the recording, noting it isn’t overly tinny or mid‑rangey and that the soundboard mix is well‑balanced. They also label the release as a keeper and one of the better MOTB issues, indicating a generally strong musical performance even though no specific songs are highlighted.

ai_rating.rationale: Two consistent 4‑star reviews focus on the excellent recording balance and overall quality of the show, yielding a solid above‑average rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear, well‑balanced mix; not too tinny or mid‑rangey; soundboard source praised for consistency.

show_quality.setlist_flow: No specific comments on set structure; reviewers consider the overall performance a keeper.
